pokedexEntries.su: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

pokedexEntries.mo: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

pokedexEntries.us: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

pokedexEntries.um: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.

pokedexEntries.sw: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

pokedexEntries.sh: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
